canonical_name: No Due Diligence on Prospective Suppliers
description: Due diligence is not performed on prospective suppliers.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of pre-contract due diligence processes for suppliers and third parties. Check for lack of planning activities or risk assessments conducted before establishing formal supplier relationships.
